recommendation: Keep this audit. If SupplyRequest.item changes are needed in the future, make them in HL7/oo-incubator unless SupplyRequest is migrated back into core.
issue_request: FHIR-26826 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and requested adding DeviceDefinition as another choice for SupplyRequest.item after Device and DeviceDefinition split, applied for R5.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-26826 source commit was found. The clone matches original issue FHIR-26301, and the R5 source conversion commit 33b409a4b6 introduced SupplyRequest.item as CodeableReference with DeviceDefinition among the targets; published R5 confirms the target is present.
additional_context: FHIR-26301 carries the original same vote and request. FHIR-26827 later closed the R4 extension/pre-adoption request as Not Persuasive because R5 already had the ability. Later product/supply work added more targets but retained DeviceDefinition. Commit 3b38b80cf2 removed SupplyRequest from active core resource registration and pointed core links to the OO Incubator; OO minutes confirmed SupplyRequest was selected for the Additional Resources path.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source edit is appropriate because SupplyRequest is outside the current core build scope and the active OO Incubator StructureDefinition already includes DeviceDefinition on SupplyRequest.item.

related_jiras.note: Original Published issue with the same SupplyRequest.item DeviceDefinition request and OO vote.
R4 pre-adoption extension request was closed Not Persuasive because R5 already had the ability.
Broader product/inventory work later added InventoryItem to SupplyRequest.item without removing DeviceDefinition.
